quote: Ciprofloxacin Injection is indicated in adult patients for treatment of acute sinusitis caused by Haemophilus influenzae
note: Acute sinusitis is an indicated upper respiratory infection; edge is a near parent, not a whole organ-system class.

quote: indicated for the treatment of sucrase deficiency, which is part of congenital sucrase-isomaltase deficiency (CSID)
note: CSID is directly named as the treated condition.

quote: Triazolam is indicated for the short-term treatment of insomnia
note: Insomnia is the named indication.

quote: indicated for the management of severe and persistent pain that requires an opioid analgesic
note: Back pain is a narrower form of the generically indicated severe persistent pain.
Supplied text covers only intravesical gemcitabine for NMIBC; breast cancer not mentioned.

quote: allergic conditions intractable to adequate trials of conventional treatment: Seasonal or perennial allergic rhinitis Bronchial asthma
note: Prednisolone syrup lists bronchial asthma; late-onset asthma is a subtype.
Indications are ulcers, GERD, hypersecretory states; lower abdominal pain not mentioned.

quote: Celecoxib Capsules is indicated for the management of AP in adults
note: Acute pain indication covers shoulder pain as narrower form (VYSCOXA negation does not override other labels).

quote: Acetaminophen Injection is indicated for the management of mild to moderate pain
note: Generic pain indication; groin pain is a narrower form.
RA (arthritis) is indicated, but interstitial lung disease is never mentioned; RA indication does not support treating the lung manifestation.

quote: indicated in the treatment of the following infections due to susceptible strains of the designated microorganisms
note: Label lists specific bacterial infections; edge "Infection" is a whole disease class.

quote: the treatment of cholestatic pruritus in patients 3 months of age and older with Alagille syndrome (ALGS)
note: Cholestatic pruritus is the named treatment target.

quote: indicated for the treatment of patients one year of age and older with gastrointestinal infections caused by Ascaris lumbricoides
note: GI helminth infections; edge is a near parent that essentially describes the indication.
Typhoid/Salmonella/enteric fever not mentioned in the ciprofloxacin injection text.

quote: indicated for treatment of adult patients with: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL)
note: CLL is named; B-cell CLL is equivalent/subtype.

quote: For the treatment of dermatomyositis, polymyositis, and systemic lupus erythematosus
note: Dermatomyositis indicated; paraneoplastic form is a subtype.

quote: Myocardial Infarction Propranolol hydrochloride tablets, USP are indicated to reduce cardiovascular mortality in patients who have survived the acute phase of myocardial infarction
note: Labelled indication heading is MI (post-MI secondary prevention); borderline with FP1.

quote: Breyanzi is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL)
note: DLBCL named in EMA indication.
Only topical betamethasone dermatoses texts; transfusion reaction not mentioned.

quote: indicated for the management of severe and persistent pain that requires an opioid analgesic
note: Myofascial pain syndrome treated as a narrower form of the generic severe persistent pain indication.
Zolpidem texts cover insomnia only; anxiety not mentioned.

quote: Atenolol tablets USP are indicated for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure
note: Systolic hypertension is a subtype of indicated hypertension.
Text relieves symptoms of "hay fever" (allergic rhinitis) and aids sleep; fever itself is not an indication (string collision).

quote: For relief of the signs and symptoms of acute gout
note: Gout is indicated; primary gout is a form of it.

quote: indicated in combination with other antiretroviral agents for the treatment of HIV-1 infection
note: Indication is HIV-1 infection; "immunodeficiency disease" is a broad class.

quote: acute nonspecific tenosynovitis; acute gouty arthritis; posttraumatic osteoarthritis; synovitis of osteoarthritis
note: Synovitis (of OA) is a listed rheumatic indication.
Combination-only text covers cIAI only; VABP/pneumonia not mentioned.

quote: systemic mastocytosis with an associated haematological neoplasm (SM-AHN)
note: SM-AHN is the synonym of the edge disease and is named in EMA indication.

quote: revascularization procedures, hospitalization for congestive heart failure, and angina in adults with clinically evident CHD
note: CHF hospitalization is a named prevented outcome; borderline as risk-reduction.

quote: indicated to reduce the risk of stroke and systemic embolism in adult patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation
note: Stroke is indicated; hemorrhagic stroke is a subtype per rubric, though text plausibly means embolic stroke (borderline).

quote: indicated for acute or long-term use for symptomatic treatment of the following: Mild to moderate pain Osteoarthritis Rheumatoid arthritis
note: OA and RA indicated; "arthritic joint disease" is a near parent.

quote: Isoniazid oral solution is recommended for all forms of tuberculosis in which organisms are susceptible
note: All forms of TB covers congenital TB.

quote: Morganella morganii, Citrobacter freundii, Pseudomonas aeruginosa
note: Citrobacter infections are listed causative organisms.

quote: visual impairment due to diabetic macular oedema (DME)
note: DME named in EMA Ozurdex indication.

quote: megaloblastic anemias due to a deficiency of folic acid (as may be seen in tropical or nontropical sprue)
note: Sprue is only background cause; treated condition is megaloblastic anemia (edge also overbroad).

quote: improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus
note: T2DM is the named indication.

quote: Infants and children: Leucine sensitivity, islet cell hyperplasia, nesidioblastosis
note: Manages hyperinsulinism (incl. familial forms like nesidioblastosis/leucine sensitivity).

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with renal angiomyolipoma and TSC
note: Renal angiomyolipoma is a named indication.
